notes: Every construct + article pair here is written with two the's, so the construct takes a supplied the and the article the one before its own word (rule 29).
Both occurrences of יִּטְּשֻׁהוּ are separately rendered, so neither is a resumptive to mark unrepresented under rule 22.
עָרִיצֵי takes the supplied the that makes it substantival (rule 46), headed on terrible.
